Metadata.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Metadata.Name: Resolution 1280x720
Metadata.Note: Forces the internal 3D render resolution to 1280x720 while preserving the normal display/output path. Reduces GPU load at the cost of image sharpness. Select only one resolution patch and restart the game.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Metadata.Name: Resolution 1600x900
Metadata.Note: Forces the internal 3D render resolution to 1600x900 while preserving the normal display/output path. Offers better image quality than 720p with a smaller GPU reduction. Select only one resolution patch and restart the game.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Metadata.Name: Disable Sun Shadows
Metadata.Note: Disables cascaded sun/directional shadow rendering through the renderer's native no-shadow path. Local-light shadows remain enabled. Can reduce GPU load in outdoor scenes; direct sun shadows are removed. Restart the game.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Metadata.Name: Disable SSAO
Metadata.Note: Disables screen-space ambient occlusion through the renderer's native inactive path while leaving Ambient Shadow available. Contact areas and corners look lighter. Restart the game.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Metadata.Name: Vehicle Density 50%
Metadata.Note: Halves the default and configured density for all three ambient vehicle categories. Scripted and mission vehicles are unaffected, so visible traffic is not guaranteed to be exactly 50%. Restart the game.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Metadata.Name: Pedestrian Generation 50%
Metadata.Note: Keeps alternating procedural pedestrian spawn candidates and halves the dynamic pedestrian population cap. Scripted and mission NPCs are unaffected, so visible population is not guaranteed to be exactly 50%. Restart the game.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22

Metadata.Title: Marvel's Spider-Man
Metadata.Name: 60 FPS
Metadata.Note: Targets 60 FPS on App 01.00 by switching the renderer frame-timing normalization from the native 1/30 reference to its adjacent 1/60 reference. Ported for the supplied 01.00 executable. Restart the game.
Metadata.Author: erickmendes22
